title: Watch the Low Stool  (当心小板凳)

segments.t: 周二晚上的厨房里，角落里烤好的酥皮正在架子上放凉。汉娜拿着菜单走进来时，泰莎正爬上一张低矮的木凳去拿大铜壶。先完整听一遍吧。
Tessa, wait, let me hold that wooden stool while you reach the top shelf!
I climb this little stool ten times a week, Hannah, I just need the big teapot... ouch!
Tessa! Grab my arm! Sit right down on this chair, do not stand up!
Ooh... my right shoe slipped on the bottom rung when I stepped down!
Let me slip your shoe off gently. Can you wiggle your toes for me?
Toes move fine, nothing broken, just a sharp twist on the outside of my ankle.
Keep your foot up on this second chair while I wrap cold ice in a clean towel.
No, no, Hannah! Tomorrow is Wednesday! I have lentil soup and twenty lemon tarts to finish!
If you stand on a swollen ankle tonight, you will not walk for two weeks!
Who will bake Wednesday's fresh bread and lemon curd if I sit in a chair?!
Look around this house, Tessa: you have six pairs of hands and one loud voice!
Wait... you want me to sit on a cushion and boss everyone around?!
现在，让我们一句一句来回味这段厨房里的小意外。
Tessa, wait, let me hold that wooden stool while you reach the top shelf!
「泰莎，等一下，你够最上面那层架子的时候让我帮你扶着那张木凳！」 没有靠背也没有扶手的凳子，英语里不叫 chair 而是叫
that wooden stool
而 top shelf 指的就是橱柜里最高的那层架子。
I climb this little stool ten times a week, Hannah, I just need the big teapot... ouch!
「这张小板凳我一星期能爬十次，汉娜，我只是需要那个大茶壶……哎哟！」 想要表达一周十次这样的频率，英语里直接在表示时间单位的词前面加上不定冠词 a，
ten times a week
紧接着就是那声全世界通用的突发疼痛呼叫：ouch，也就是我们的“哎哟”！
Tessa! Grab my arm! Sit right down on this chair, do not stand up!
「泰莎！抓住我的手臂！马上坐到这张椅子上，别站起来！」 在紧急情况下，比起 take，这个动作感极强的动词
Grab my arm
更能传达出让人赶紧死死抓住自己以防摔倒的急迫感。
Ooh... my right shoe slipped on the bottom rung when I stepped down!
「呃……我踩下来的时候，右脚的鞋在最下面那根横档上滑了一下！」 不管是在梯子上还是在木凳上，供脚踩踏的那根横木或踏板都叫
the bottom rung
而 stepped down 描绘了向下迈步的动作。
Let me slip your shoe off gently. Can you wiggle your toes for me?
「让我轻轻把你的鞋脱下来。你能帮我动动脚趾头吗？」 刚才用来表示滑倒的同一个动词 slip，在这里变成了及物动词并加上了 off，
slip your shoe off
形象地表达出鞋子顺滑地脱落下来的过程，紧接着的 wiggle your toes 意思是左右扭动脚趾头。
Toes move fine, nothing broken, just a sharp twist on the outside of my ankle.
「脚趾活动正常，没有骨折，只是脚踝外侧猛地扭了一下。」 用一种电报式般让人安心的简练口吻，
nothing broken
在 nothing 和过去分词之间不需要加上动词，而 a sharp twist 准确地形容了那种突如其来的剧烈扭伤。
Keep your foot up on this second chair while I wrap cold ice in a clean towel.
「把你的脚放在第二张椅子上抬高，我去用干净毛巾包点冰块。」 只用三个简单的单词，就把日常急救的指令说得清清楚楚：
Keep your foot up
英语习惯在这里用物主代词 your foot，而中文更习惯说“把脚抬高”。
No, no, Hannah! Tomorrow is Wednesday! I have lentil soup and twenty lemon tarts to finish!
「不，不行，汉娜！明天就是周三了！我还有扁豆汤和二十个柠檬挞要做完！」 在列举完一堆吃的之后放在句尾，这个结构
twenty lemon tarts to finish
用一个简单的带 to 的不定式，利落地表达了接下来要完成的任务。
If you stand on a swollen ankle tonight, you will not walk for two weeks!
「要是你今晚还用肿胀的脚踝站着，你接下来两个星期都别想走路了！」 在表达对未来的警告时，if 引导的条件句用一般现在时，而结果句用将来时：
you will not walk for two weeks
这里的 for 引出了一整段不能走路的持续时间。
Who will bake Wednesday's fresh bread and lemon curd if I sit in a chair?!
「要是我坐在椅子上，谁来烤周三的新鲜面包和做柠檬凝乳？！」 这是英美烘焙界里一大经典配料：
lemon curd
指的就是那种用柠檬、鸡蛋、糖和黄油做成的细腻酸甜的柠檬凝乳，常用来做馅料。
Look around this house, Tessa: you have six pairs of hands and one loud voice!
「看看这个屋子周围，泰莎：你有六双好帮手的手，外加一副大嗓门！」 为了统计随时准备帮忙的六个朋友，汉娜用了个十分形象的量词：
six pairs of hands
还有后面那句 one loud voice，幽默地点出了这位糕点师平时元气满满的性格！
Wait... you want me to sit on a cushion and boss everyone around?!
「等等……你想让我坐在垫子上，然后对大家发号施令？！」 口语里常用的名词 boss （老板），在这里摇身一变成了带着介词的动词短语：
boss everyone around
意思是坐在椅子上对大家指手画脚、发号施令！现在，用自然语速把整个场景再听一遍吧。
Tessa, wait, let me hold that wooden stool while you reach the top shelf!
I climb this little stool ten times a week, Hannah, I just need the big teapot... ouch!
Tessa! Grab my arm! Sit right down on this chair, do not stand up!
Ooh... my right shoe slipped on the bottom rung when I stepped down!
Let me slip your shoe off gently. Can you wiggle your toes for me?
Toes move fine, nothing broken, just a sharp twist on the outside of my ankle.
Keep your foot up on this second chair while I wrap cold ice in a clean towel.
No, no, Hannah! Tomorrow is Wednesday! I have lentil soup and twenty lemon tarts to finish!
If you stand on a swollen ankle tonight, you will not walk for two weeks!
Who will bake Wednesday's fresh bread and lemon curd if I sit in a chair?!
Look around this house, Tessa: you have six pairs of hands and one loud voice!
Wait... you want me to sit on a cushion and boss everyone around?!
没有骨折，泰莎扭伤的脚踝上也敷上了冷冰块，而且汉娜已经想好了周三早上的救援计划！我们下个场景见。
Take care!
